policy: A release must preserve every required feature unless the owner explicitly approves its removal.

requiredFeatures.name: Backend health endpoint
requiredFeatures.testCommand: GET /health returns HTTP 200 and expected service fields

requiredFeatures.name: Authenticated chat and NDJSON streaming
requiredFeatures.testCommand: Authenticated /api/chat returns valid delta/done events consumed by the Android parser

requiredFeatures.name: Persistent memory in PostgreSQL
requiredFeatures.testCommand: Create, retrieve, update/correct and delete memory; verify after a new session

requiredFeatures.name: Learning/correction event persistence
requiredFeatures.testCommand: Record a correction, restart the service, and verify the event remains retrievable

requiredFeatures.name: Selective web search through Exa
requiredFeatures.testCommand: A query requiring current research invokes search and cites returned sources; normal chat does not falsely claim a search

requiredFeatures.name: Android microphone / speech recognition
requiredFeatures.testCommand: Grant microphone permission, recognize speech, and send the resulting text

requiredFeatures.name: Android text-to-speech output
requiredFeatures.testCommand: Receive a response and verify text-to-speech playback can start and stop

requiredFeatures.name: Existing Android UI and hologram view
requiredFeatures.testCommand: Launch the app, render the main screen and hologram view, and verify no startup crash

removalPolicy: Never remove a required feature merely because a new feature was added. A removal requires explicit owner approval and a recorded reason.
